Definition: neuter singular of G5036 (as adverb); shortly, i.e. without delay, soon, or (by surprise) suddenly, or (by implication, of ease) readily:--lightly, quickly.
BiblicalUsage: The angel tells the women to go quickly and tell the disciples He is risen; Mary rises quickly when she hears Jesus is calling; and Jesus Himself says, surely I come quickly. The word is an adverb of swiftness, and it runs through the New Testament like a messenger: go quickly, come quickly, rise quickly.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the last use is the one to hold onto: He says He comes quickly, and the whole church answers, even so, come, Lord Jesus.
